name: fastsim_beam_point
note: Validation study for the fastsimkit task beam_point (umbrella mu2e-fastsim beam/, package beamfastsim) on Fermilab EAF, not an optimisation: zero knobs, two steps on one A100 MIG slice. Each step transports the 105,350 MDC2025ac DS-entrance muons (table made from MuBeamCat with the stock MuBeamResampler G4 reference) through the DS field map and a stopping-target geometry, and returns the stopping fraction and stop profile. nominal is geom_common (37 foils); move is beam/geom/move_extras12.txt (49 foils). Geant4 on the same muons gives 0.3592 and 0.6693. Run with graph.run from a FNAL host with EAF_TOKEN_FILE and M2FS_CODE set; needs mu2e-fastsim-core 6ad9f3f and umbrella 96ad212.
